additional_info.subject: Q-feedback 2310- Delamination HMI 170000465
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am opening the above ticket following a delamination issue with the HMI screens under Q-feedback2310.
As you can see, a severe delamination issue has developed on the screen that cannot display an image.
In addition to the delamination issue, "bubbles" have developed around the screen GEN1 of D-Logic
.
This ticket is being formally opened so that we can file a warranty claim.
A photo of the charging station is attached.
Best regards,
Orel
